title: Power cut, people are safe

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: The power has been out since morning.

transcript_stream.speaker: operator
transcript_stream.text: Is anyone trapped, or is there water near the house?

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: No water. We are fine. We have candles.

transcript_stream.speaker: operator
transcript_stream.text: Where is the house, at district level?

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: Den Chai District, Phrae, near the invented clock tower.

transcript_stream.speaker: operator
transcript_stream.text: Do you need a medic or a rescue?

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: No. I only want to know when the power comes back.
